additional_info.subject: ID0465169-DC/Si-D/AT-[Y2/T3314161484001] Error flags were triggered. CRM:02681001161
additional_info.body:
Dear
Johannes
,
Following your request, and after checking the logs, we found that there were three charging sessions occurring on chargers DC2, DC3, and DC4.
The DC4 charger was stuck at 91%. The issue was related to KF-201 in the dispenser. After that, one of the clients pressed the emergency button, which caused all active charging sessions to fail.
We have sent screenshots showing all the charging session steps.
With best regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team
